decision: Temporary acceptance of Standard_LRS for application storage staging/prod; align IaC. No regional-copy equivalence.
residualRisk: Local Blob PITR/versioning/change feed and Cosmos backup retention do not replace an interregional copy of application storage. Regional failure can cause unavailability or data loss.
invalidation: Any change to templates, effective parameters, governance policies, deployments or measured resources requires fresh evidence; inventory window remains historical.

limitations: Activity Log is control-plane evidence, not data-plane inventory.
Request bodies show submitted values, not a before/after diff or proof every supplied property changed.
Succeeded policy auditIfNotExists events are evaluations, not successful resource mutations.
Started, Accepted, Canceled and Succeeded retained separately; no Failed events observed.
Window completeness is limited to events returned by ARM at collection time; delayed ingestion remains possible.
Raw pages, request/response data and what-if remain local with SHA-256; no raw claims, caller IP, emails, tags or free-text response bodies are published.
No rg-certigo-ci, runner patching, content stack, data changes, apply, access change or production what-if.
